summary: DR. KLEMS KLINIKK AS (org. no. 999 615 694) is a private limited company (AS) based in Arendal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2013-01-30. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 86.221 (Spesialiserte legetjenester, unntatt psykiatriske legetjenester); it has 6 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 9.6 m and net income was NOK 3.3 m. CEO: Knut Henning Klem; board chair: Knut Henning Klem; auditor: IREVISJON AS.
